purpose: Teach: 人脈/吟味/分岐/社交/やり直し/斬新/持ち帰り/ごまかし

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: クライアント開拓、人脈、活用しよう。
lines.en: Let's develop new client relationships and leverage our existing networks.
lines.style: Crisp, purposeful opening. Slight lean forward. Energy confident but not rushed. Casual authority — this is the plan.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。提案書、文言を丁寧に吟味します。
lines.en: Got it. I'll go through the proposal wording carefully.
lines.style: Steady, reliable agreement. No hesitation. Direct eye contact. Warm enough to show he's on her side, not just taking orders.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プロジェクトの分岐、月内に決めよう。
lines.en: We need to decide on the project directions by month's end.
lines.style: Clear instruction tone. Slight pause before the deadline to let it land. Not harsh, but decisive. She's mapping out the timeline.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 社交イベントの企画も、進めます。
lines.en: I'll move forward with planning the social event too.
lines.style: Steady update delivered without fanfare. Practical, showing progress. Slightly faster pace — he's got momentum.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 昨年の失敗、やり直し版で挽回したいね。
lines.en: I really want to make up for what went wrong last year with a better version this time.
lines.style: Softer, more personal. Quiet vulnerability underneath the professionalism. She's speaking from something that matters. Slight pause before 'better version' — searching for the right frame.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 斬新なアイデア、社内コンペでも集まっています。
lines.en: Fresh ideas are already coming in from the internal competitions.
lines.style: Upbeat, genuinely encouraging. Light brightness in the tone — he's pleased with this progress. Pace slightly quicker, almost conversational.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 資料の持ち帰り厳禁、徹底を。
lines.en: Documents absolutely cannot leave the office — make sure everyone understands that.
lines.style: Sharp, non-negotiable. Decisive attack on the opening. Firm but not angry. The tone of someone who's seen what happens when this rule breaks.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ごまかしの言葉、絶対避けます。
lines.en: We absolutely won't use any misleading language.
lines.style: Steady conviction. No hedging. He means this. Direct but not defensive — stating a principle they both hold.
